_meta.purpose: A7 V3 comp audit golden set (REQUIREMENTS.md A7-14). Each case is a subject plus a comp set; expected.prefilter is what the deterministic pre-filters must flag per comp, expected.flagged the final (pre-filter + model) flags per comp, expected.model_flags what the scripted model adds in mock mode. The model may add flags and never removes a pre-filter flag.
